clues.it: Dario era da solo in Armeria.
clues.en: Dario was alone in the Armory.

clues.it: Anna era l'unica seduta su una sedia.
clues.en: Anna was the only one sitting on a chair.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Bruno era l'unica persona su un tappeto.
clues.en: Bruno was the only person on a rug.

clues.it: Fabio era accanto a una libreria.
Marta era da sola nelle Segrete.
clues.en: Marta was alone in the Dungeon.

steps.it: Solo Dario può stare nella 1ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 7ª è sua.
steps.en: Dario is the only one who can be in the 1st row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 7th is theirs.

steps.it: Solo Anna può stare nella 2ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 1ª è sua.
steps.en: Anna is the only one who can be in the 2nd row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 1st is theirs.

steps.en: Elena is the only one who can be in the 3rd row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 3rd is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Bruno più le righe e le colonne già occupate lasciano una sola casella: riga 4ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: Bruno's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 4th, column 4th.

steps.en: Marta's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 7th, column 2nd.
